name: Atlas Release Readiness
summary: A local-first desktop product preparing a bounded release candidate review.
problem: Scattered release evidence can make provider completion look like product readiness.
desiredOutcome: Produce a traceable readiness observation without modifying source files or contacting a provider.
successSignals: The run is bound to an exact preview and governed context
Provider completion and outcome status remain separately recorded
The resulting evidence can be independently verified
firstWorkflow: Review a fixed release evidence packet through the offline managed runtime.
